server_instructions: STEALTHEYE is a privileged Windows capability substrate controlled by ChatGPT. Prefer precise typed operations, then direct CLI/file operations, then browser CDP, then Windows UI Automation, and use raw eye_run only when no narrower operation fits. Long work should become durable jobs; wait on events instead of polling; move large data by artifact reference. Reuse stable IDs, incarnations, and cursors. For consequential effects, use stable task_id/action_id plus a deterministic postcondition so retries are idempotent and evidence-backed. ChatGPT remains the planner; STEALTHEYE does not autonomously plan or declare unverified completion.
summary: Five effect-class capability tools plus one UI-only Eye Live tool over one stable host and one supervised versioned capability engine.

tools.name: eye_inspect
tools.description: Read, search, observe, query, wait, subscribe, and diagnose StealthEye machine state.

tools.name: eye_run
tools.description: Run SYSTEM, active-user, WSL, process, PowerShell, terminal, and ConPTY execution operations.

tools.name: eye_change
tools.description: Apply precisely typed local file, machine, service, package, storage, snapshot, and configuration changes.

tools.name: eye_interact
tools.description: Interact with Windows applications, UI Automation, input, clipboard, and Chrome/CDP user interfaces.

tools.name: eye_external
tools.description: Perform HTTP, upload, send, post, provider administration, remote transfer, and other effects leaving the laptop.

tools.name: eye_live
tools.description: Open the Eye Live mission, job, trigger, artifact, and relay component. This tool performs no machine operation itself.

architectural_primitives.observe: Structured machine, UI, browser, process, file, job, artifact, and event state.
architectural_primitives.act: Raw execution or precise typed changes/interactions/external effects.
architectural_primitives.wait: Event-driven condition waiting exposed as typed operations, primarily through eye_inspect rather than a separate top-level tool.
architectural_primitives.transfer: Artifact and file movement exposed as typed operations in the appropriate effect facade rather than a separate top-level tool.

file_inputs.chatgpt_bridge: top-level file parameters via _meta[openai/fileParams] where applicable

activation_gate: host-engine protocol and contract-hash handshake exist
